name: Westfield Century City
description: Westfield Century City is a premier luxury shopping destination in the heart of Los Angeles, featuring an impressive open-air design with over 200 stores including high-end retailers like Bloomingdale's, Nordstrom, Tiffany & Co., and Alo Yoga. The center offers world-class dining at Eataly, Din Tai Fung, and Katsuya, complemented by entertainment options including AMC Theatres and unique experiences like American Girl and CAMP. With its sophisticated architectural design, curated tenant mix, and proximity to Beverly Hills, it stands as one of Southern California's most prestigious retail and lifestyle destinations.
demographics: Westfield Century City attracts an affluent, cosmopolitan demographic with a median household income exceeding $100,000, drawing primarily from the Westside communities of Beverly Hills, Bel Air, and West Los Angeles. The visitor base skews toward professionals aged 25-54, families with higher disposable incomes, and international tourists seeking luxury shopping experiences. The trade area is characterized by high educational attainment, cultural diversity, and strong preference for premium brands, fine dining, and entertainment experiences. Shoppers typically exhibit sophisticated tastes with spending patterns focused on designer fashion, upscale beauty products, and experiential retail.
summary: A luxury open-air shopping center in Los Angeles featuring over 200 upscale stores, fine dining, and entertainment in a sophisticated architectural setting near Beverly Hills.
